items.title: The 8:30: Trump-Xi summit takeaways, an interview with Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella
items.summary: The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley break down the biggest market and business stories driving the day's conversation. From the latest updates from President Trump's summit with Xi Jinping to Costco's (COST) latest earnings, The 8:30 panel delivers the essential headlines and market context you need to start your day informed. Deirdre Bosa also comes on to discuss her recent interview with Microsoft (MSFT) CEO Satya Nadella.

items.title: Is LLY Stock Cheaper Than It Looks?
items.summary: At about $1,182 a share, Eli Lilly (LLY) stock trades at about 33.1 times trailing earnings. Those are adjusted earnings: normalized net income with stock-based compensation added back, a basis built to sit close to the one analysts use in their forecasts. That looks expensive. Whether it is depends on two obesity drugs, on margins and on how much Lilly spends buying new medicines.

items.title: What Could Pfizer (PFE) Unlock From Faster FDA Reviews And Orphan Drug Growth?
items.summary: Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) is focusing more of its research pipeline on therapies eligible for FDA Breakthrough Therapy and orphan drug status. The FDA has widened use of Breakthrough Therapy designations in areas such as oncology, which can shorten review and approval timelines.
